/zhes so/ /'phrul dga' la sogs pa la dgod pas tshims pa'i 'dod chags yod/ de la spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs/ yang de nyid las/ mgon po ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ /de yi g.yon phyogs lha mo ni/ /cung zad yid ni 'dzum bcas bri/ /zhes so/ /dga' ldan la sogs pa la 'khyud pas tshim pa la/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsungs/ rdo rje rtse mo nas/ lha mo ca co rab sgrogs pa/ /dbus 'gyur rang gi rim pa ni/ /'dzum bcas kun tu lta ba ste/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la 'khyud/ /ces so/ /sum cu rtsa gsum pa man chad dbang po gnyis sbyor gyis tshim pa rnams dang sgo bstun nas rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud gsungs/ bde mchog rtsa rgyud nas/ mtshan ma gnyis la sngags sbyar te/ /sngags pas mkha' 'gro ma la sbyar/ /blo dang rnal 'byor ma 'grub bya/ /zhes so/ /gsang 'dus las kyang / sngags kyi skyes bu ji snyed pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyis ye shes rdzogs/ /dbang po gnyis kyi sbyor ba yis/ /dbang po thams cad brtag par bya/ /zhes so/ /nyams len sgrub tshul gzhi dang sgo bstun pa ni/ bya ba'i rgyud kyi sgrub tshul ni rang dam tshig pa dang lha ye shes sems dpa' gnyis rje 'bangs kyi tshul du sgrub pa ste/ de'ang rtog pa bsdus pa'i rgyud las/ don dam spros bral stong pa'i ngang nyid las/ /kun rdzob sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gnas pa'i/ /rje 'bangs tshul gyis dad pas rab bsgom na/ /dngos grub dam pa sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi sgrub tshul ni/ grogs po'i tshul du bsgom pa ste/ blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i rgyud las/ don dam rnam dag ye shes chen po la/ /sgyu ma'i skur ston grogs po'i tshul du bsgom/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i sngags kyi lam nyid kyis/ /thar pa chen po'i byang chub nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /rnal 'byor gyi rgyud kyi sgrub tshul ni/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa spyan drangs shing /

mchod bstod byas nas rang la bstims pas/ thog mar bzang ngan cung zad yod kyang / phyis zangs la gser 'gyur gyi rtsis btab pa bzhin du tha dad med par bsgom pa ste/ dam tshig mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud las/ rang rig ye shes lha yi sku/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa ltar/ /dbyer med bsgom pas byang chub 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi sgrub tshul ni/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa bstims kyang rung / ma bstims kyang rung / thog ma nyid nas gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa dang bral bar shes shing sgom pa ste/ dpal dam tshig chen po'i rgyud nas/ bde ba chen po'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa 'o/ /dpal ldan chos kyi sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa 'o/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa 'o/ /sprul pa yi yang sku gsung thugs/ /ye shes gcig sbyor sdom pa 'o/ /zhes so/ /da ni rgyud sde bzhi po'i 'thad pa sgrub pa la bzhi ste/ rgyud sde re re'i dgongs pa bshad pa dang / byung bsdebs kyi khyad par bshad pa'o/ /dang po rgyud sde bzhi'i lta ba dang / sgom pa dang / spyod pa dang / 'bras bu dang bzhi bzhis ston te/ de la bya ba'i rgyud kyis lta ba ni/ bden pa gnyis su 'dod de/ de la don dam pa'i bden pa ni/ stong gsal ye shes kyi mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'o/ /kun rdzob kyi bden pa ni gnyis te/ yang dag pa'i kun rdzob dang / log 'khrul pa'i snang ba yin pas mi 'dor ro/ /pa'i kun rdzob pa'o/ /yang dag pa la gnyis/ dngos po'i gshis dang / gdul bya blo'i snang ba'o/ /dang po kri ya'i+i snang ba thams cad chos nyid rtogs pa'i yon tan gyi snang bar 'dod la/ gdul bya blo'i snang ba ni yon tan gyi snang ba de nyid gdul bya'i blo la rigs gsum du gyes pas/ gsum tshan lnga'i rang bzhin du snang ba ste/

de yang nang gi gtso bo gsum lus ngag yid gsum/ rigs kyis gtso bo rnam snang 'od dpag med mi bskyod pa gsum du dag pa/ phyi'i snang ba mtho dma' 'jam rtsub la sogs pa rigs kyi bdag po 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs phyag rdor gsum du dag cing / phyi nang gi 'byung ba rnams ni rigs kyi spyan ma gos dkar ma dbyings kyi/ lha mo gsum du dag cing / gsang ba dug gsum kyang rigs kyi khro bo gshin rje gshed rta mgrin bdud rtsi 'khyil ba/ gsum du dag de las gzhan pa'i sbyang gzhi rnams ni rigs kyi pho nya gsum du dag go de ltar yang kun rdzob rang bzhin rigs gsum sku/ /kun kyang dag phyir gsum tshan lnga/ /zhes so/ /sgom pa ni/ bskyed pa dang / rdzogs pa ste/ bskyed pa ni/ dam tshig pa'i bya ba dang / ye shes pa'i bya ba'o/ /dam tshig pa la kri ya don gyi lha drug ste/ de yang rigs gtad la sogs pa sta gon gyi chos rnams sngon du song nas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par bsgom pa ni stong pa chos nyid kyi lha/ de'i ngang las snying po brjod par snang ba ni grags pa sgra'i lha/ de nas a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa ni gnas pa gdan gyi lha/ de'i steng du sa bon bskyed pa ni gsung yig 'bru'i lha/ de gyur pa phyag mtshan yig 'brus mtshan pa ni thugs phyag mtshan gyi lha/ de yongs su gyur pa las lha bskyed pa ni sku yongs su rdzogs pa'i lha'o/ /de ltar yang mkha' 'gro ma mi gcig brtsegs pa'i rgyud las/ dang po stong pa chos nyid sgra/ /yid 'bru phyag mtshan ye shes lha/ /yongs su rdzogs pa sku yi lha/ /de ltar drug gi lha bskyed do/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gnas pa'i lha drug ni/ sems dpa' gsum dam tshig pa rang ye shes pa ting nge 'dzin dang u rgyan gyi lha sku gsung thugs gsum mo/ /ye shes pa'i bya ba drug ni/ snyan gsan dbab pa/

spyan drang ba/ bzhugs su gsol ba dang / de'i sngon du sdig pa bshags pa dang / mchod pa 'bul ba dang / che ba yon tan gyis bstod pa'o/ /de nas gsal ba gsum ldan gyi sgo nas 'phro 'du'i rnal 'byor sgom pa ni/ phar 'phros/ mchod cing gsol ba'i tshul dang / tshur 'dus pas sdig pa dag cing dngos grub stsol ba'i tshul lo/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ yig 'bru rdo rje nas tsam zhig thig le dang / na da la dmigs pa ni/ mtshan bcas lhar snang rig sbyor ba yin/ rig stong mtha' bzhi dang bral ba'i ni mtshan med do/ /de yang yo ga'i 'grel pa las/ rdo rje phra mo'i sbyor ba yis/ /bdag nyid zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /rang nyid bsgom par bya ba ni/ /byang chub sems ni bsgom pa yin/ /zhes so/ /spyod pa ni bya ba drug gis 'jug pa ste/ 'jug pa dus tshigs kyis dang / dmigs pa rten gyis dang / bgo ba gos kyis dang / bza' ba zas kyis dang / gtsang sbra khrus kyis dang / bzlas brjod sngags kyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar yang / sgo gsum rdo rje gtso ru bstan/ /gnod spangs phan pa sgrub byed cing / /rgyal ba nyid kyis rjes su slob/ /rig pa 'dzin pa'i bya ba yin/ /zhes so/ /'bras bu ni/ rigs gsum rdo rje 'dzin pas sangs rgyas sku gsum ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid thob par 'dod pa'o/ /gnyis pa spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lta ba ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes su mthun par 'dod de/ don dam kun rdzob gnyis dngos po'i gshis snang brjod tshul gong dang 'dra/ gdul bya'i blo snang ni/ rigs bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ dpon g.yog gam/ grogs po'i tshul du 'dod la/ de'ang yul yul can gyi sgo nas bsdu ba dang / bya ba byed pa'i tshul du bsdu ba dang / ji skad du/ yul dang yul can gyi bya ba byed/ gang rung zhig tu bsdu ba'o/ /sgom pa ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang mthun pa/ spyod pa ni bya ba'i rgyud dang mthun pa/ de ltar yang /

gnyis ka'i rgyud kyi 'dod pa la/ lta spyod gong 'og rjes su mthun/ /zhes so/ /'bras bu sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan du 'dod pa'o/ /mtshan brjod las/ sangs rgyas sku lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag /ces so/ /gsum pa rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lta ba ni/ spyir bden pa gnyis ldan/ don dam ni chos dbyings ye shes kyi mtha' dang bral bar 'dod la/ cir snang thams cad chos nyid rtogs pa'i byin rlabs kyi snang ba yin la/ gdul bya'i blo snang ni/ rig pa rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la/ de yang gtso bo la yab yum bzhi dang / phyag mtshan sbas pa dang lnga/ rgyal ba rigs bzhi la rigs byung gi sems dpa' bzhi bzhis bskor ba/ phyi nang gi lha mo bzhi bzhi ste brgyad/ sgo ba bzhi ste lha sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs par snang ba la/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ni tha dad cung zad yod mod kyis/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim nas/ gcig tshul gcig tu lta ba'o/ /de ltar yang chos dbyings kyi ye shes su/ rtogs pa'i byin rlabs lha ru snang / /zhes so/ /sgom pa ni/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis las/ dang po la'ang gnyis/ sngon byang lnga ni sta gon gyi chos sngon du song nas/ stong pa nyid las dang / gdan pad zla dang / gsung yig 'bru dang / thugs phyag mtshan las dang / sku yongs su rdzogs pa la byang chub pa'o/ /cho 'phrul bzhi ni/ ting nge 'dzin dang / dbang bskur ba'i dang / byin gyis brlabs pa'i dang / mchod pa'i cho 'phrul lo/ /rdzogs rim mtshan bcas snga ma dang 'dra/ mtshan med ni chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' dwangs pa ltar mtha' bzhi dang bral bar mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ dpal bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyud las/ chos rnams gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /rang rig sgom pa mkha' mnyam ste/ /zhes so/ 'bras bu sku gsum dbye ba dang bcas 'dod mod kyi/ chos sku dang sprul sku gnyis thun mong gi longs sku 'og min gyi gnas nas/

dpal rnam par snang mdzad bde ba chen po dus gsum du mi 'gyur bar longs spyod par 'dod do/ /de'ang dpal mchog dang po nas/ rnam par snang mdzad chen po rtag /dus gsum mnyam pa nyid la bzhugs/ /zhes so/ /da ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi lta ba ni/ 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs skye med rang dag shar lugs 'gag pa rang shar/ grol lugs spros bral rang grol ba/ mtha' gang du yang ma lhung ba/ rgya gang du yang ma chad pa ste/ mdor na gnyis chos gnyis med thams cad las rang grol ba'o/ /de ltar yang do ha las/ gdod nas dag pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin las/ /bltas shing bltas shing mthong ba 'gag par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /gsang 'dus las/ kun tu yod pa dang bral zhing / /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /chos bdag med pa mnyam pa nyid/ /rang sems gdod nas ma skyes pa/ /stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no/ /zhes pa la sogs pa mang ngo / /sgom pa ni/ spyir rang sgom byed ma grub/ yang 'dus pa las/ dngos po med pas sgom pa med/ /de la dngos po dngos med pas/ /bsgom par bya ba bsgom pa min/ /zhes pa'o/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor pa'i blo don thog tu 'khrid par bya ba'i phyir/ goms par bya ba la sogs pa'i thabs su/ bskyed rim dang / rdzogs rim dang / zung 'jug sgom pa dang / spyod pa bya ba/ 'bras bu'i rim pa rnams gong du bshad zin to// //da ni byung bsdebs dang khyad par bshad pa la gnyis te/ rgyud kyi byung khungs bshad pa dang / phyi nang gnyis la sogs pa khyad par bstan pa'o/ /dang po bya ba'i rgyud la 'ching lugs gsum/ spyi dang bye brag tu 'ching ba dang / sku gsung thugs su 'ching ba dang / byung tshul brgyad du 'ching ba'o/ /dang po ltar na spyi rgyud bzhi ste/ mchod pa dang gtor ma/ mchod bstod gtso bor ston pa legs sgrub pa dang / dkyil 'khor gtso bor ston pa gsang ba spyi rgyud dang /

ting nge 'dzin gtso bor ston pa bsam gtan phyi ma dang / spyod pa gtso bor ston pa dpung pa bzang po dang / bye brag gi sku gsung thugs gsum dbye ba 'og nas 'byung ngo / /sku gsung thugs su 'ching na/ sku'i rtsa rgyud gtsug tor chen mo/ bshad rgyud 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud/ mngon par byang chub pa/ gsang bdag rnam par grol ba/ glu blangs 'jam dpal rdo rje phreng ba la sogs pa'i 'jam dpal gyi phyogs rnams dang / yang dpung bzang / gtsug tor gdugs dkar/ rdo rje sa 'og su si ta ka la sogs pa'o/ /gsung gi rgyud las/ rtsa rgyud pad+ma brtsegs pa/ bshad rgyud ni pad+ma cod paṇa/ don yod zhags pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ yid bzhin 'khor/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba/ zhal bcu gcig pa/ za ma tog bkod pa/ rang byung ye shes/ snying gyur cig pa/ dam tshig gsum bkod/ dngos grub bum pa la sogs pa'o/ /thugs kyi rgyud ni/ rtsa rgyud rig pa mchog bshad rgyud ni mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba/ me lce 'bar ba/ rngam pa klog drag po sum 'dus/ gzungs ring rdo rje be sde brgyad 'dul ba gtso bor ston pa/ con/ 'byung po 'dul byed/ rdo rje rnam 'joms gos sngon/ sa 'og klu dang sa bdag 'dul ba gtso bor ston pa/ 'dul ba/ gtum po rgyud gsum/ mnyam pa med pa/ ral pa gyen brdzes la sogs pa'o/ /mi g.yo ba'i rtog pa bdun pa/ rgya mtsho 'khyil ba/ bdud rtsi 'od/ bdud rtsi rab 'khyil/ stobs po che/ khro bo spyi 'dus/ bsam gtan phyi ma la sogs pa'o/ /sgrol ma la/ sgrol ma mngon par 'byung ba/ dngos grub bum pa/ gzungs gra lnga/ tsun rda/ lu gu rgyud/ 'od zer can/ ri khrod ma/ ku ru kul+le'i rtog pa la sogs pa'o/ /byung tshul brgyad ltar na/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu las gdugs dkar can/ ljags las pad+ma brtsegs pa/ dpung pa las dpung pa bzang po/ thugs las mchog gi dngos grub gtso 'khor ston pa/ rig pa mchog

phyag las dbang bskur gtso bor ston pa/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba/ lte ba las thun mong gi dngos grub gtso bor ston pa/ su ti ka ra/ gsang ba la a mo ga pa sha zhabs las 'byung po 'dul byed byung ba ste/ de dag las ma 'phros pas gzhan dag go /zhes pa/ mdor na mdo sde dang / gzungs 'bum gyi nang nas la la rtog pa zhes brjod/ kha cig la gzungs zhes bya ste/ shin tu mang bar bzhugs so/ /de nas spyod rgyud la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ sku bskyed pa gtso bor ston pa/ rnal 'byor mngon par byung ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud la kun nas bkod pa/ rgyan chen po/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bkra shis rtags brgyad gnas brgyad nas/ rgyud sde re re byung ste/ rgyud brgyad du 'dod pa'o/ /glang po che rol pa bde ba'i myu gu/ rol pa mchog kha cig ni rnam snang sgyu 'phrul dra ba dang / gsang ba spyi rgyud yin par 'dod la/ kha cig ni spyod pa'i rgyud mi 'dod pa/ ngo bor med par yang gnang ngo / /rnal 'byor rgyud la de kho na nyid yin/ gsung bskyed pa gtso bor ston pa khams gsum zil gnon gyi rgyud/ thugs bskyed pa gtso bor ston pa rnam par snang mdzad chen po'i rgyud/ rnam snang mngon byang rgyud la lnga ste/ chos nyid stong pa nyid la byang chub pa'i tshe/ stong nyid sgra sgrogs kyi rgyud dang / gdan pad zla las byang chub pa'i tshe zla ba 'khyil ba'i rgyud dang / gsung yig 'bru la mngon par byang chub pa'i tshe/ phyag rgya yongs su bsgyur ba'i rgyud/ sku yongs rdzogs la mngon par byang chub pa'i tshe dpe byad yongs su dag pa'i rgyud/ 'dus pa dum bu bzhi dang / bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje rtse mo/ dpal mchog dang po/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ dam tshig mngon par byang chub pa/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rgyud gsum/ ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud la rtog pa bdun cu ste/ 'jig rten pa yi rtog pa bcu/

de las 'das pa'i rtog pa bcu/ gang zag dman pa la dgongs pa'i rtog pa bcu/ las thams cad la dgongs pa'i rtog pa bcu/ mchog sgrub pa'i rtog pa bcu/ sku gsung thugs mnyes pa'i rtog pa bcu/ dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i rtog pa bcu ste bdun cu'o/ /de nas mchog tu gyur pa bla na med pa'i rgyud la gsum/ thabs rtsa rgyud gsang ba 'dus pa le'u go brgyad pa/ pha'i rgyud dang / shes rab ma'i rgyud dang / gnyis su med pa'i rgyud do/ /pha'i rgyud la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud bum pa/ bshad rgyud ni/ bshad pa'i rgyud la rdo rje phreng ba/ 'dra/ lha mo bzhis zhus pa/ dgongs pa lung ston/ 'dra/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa/ gzhan yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'o/ /'phags pa dang cha mthun pa'i rgyud la gshin rje gshed dgra nag gdong drug pa la/ dmar po 'jigs byed/ de dag gi bshad rgyud/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro snyoms par 'jug pa gsang ba'i rgyud/ khro bo bcu'i rgyud/ sngags don gsal ba rdo rje rgyas 'debs/ rdo rje dri ma med pa/ dbang bskur kun nas bkod pa/ snying po 'byung ba mngon par byang chub pa la sogs pa'o/ /shes rab ma'i rgyud la kun gyi rtsa ba rdo rje sems dpa' kun nas bkod pa'i rgyud de'i rnam dbye las/ shes rab gtso bor ston pa/ sku'i rgyud dges pa rdo rje/ gsung gi rgyud mahā ma ya/ thugs kyi rgyud thabs gtso bor ston pa/ bde mchog 'khor lo/ yon tan gyi rgyud thig le chen po/ 'phrin las kyi rgyud rdo rje gdan bzhi/ de la dges rdor sku'i rgyud kyi rtsa rgyud 'bum phrag lnga mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag na yod/ pa/ mi yul du spyod pa'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud thun mong ma yin pa/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur/ thun mong ba saṃ bhu ṭi la sogs pa ste/ de nas rgyud sde bcu drug gi dgos pa bstan pa'o/

/gzhan yang ye shes thig le/ ye shes rol pa/ dga' chen ston pa/……yang na ma rgyud sde drug ste/ bde ba tsakra byin rlabs kyi rgyud/ dges rdor man ngag gi rgyud/ mahā ma ya dam tshig gi rgyud/ rdo rje gdan bzhi gtsug gi rgyud/ sangs rgyas thod pa'i rgyud/ sgyu ma bde mchog gi rgyud/ bde mchog gi rgyud la dbye na/ rtsa rgyud rgyas pa le'u 'bum pa dang / 'bring po sho lo ka 'bum pa dang / bsdus pa le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa'o/ /ma ning gi rgyud ni/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud/ dur khrod rgyan la sogs pa rtsa rgyud sum cu rtsa gnyis pa dang / yan lag gi rgyud grangs las 'das so/ /de skad du/ rtsa ba'i rgyud ni rnam pa gsum/ /bshad pa'i rgyud ni sum cu gnyis/ /yan lag rgyud ni grangs las 'das/ /zhes gsungs so/ /yang kha cig bdun du yang bzhed de/ rtsa rgyud gnyis ni/ rgyud rgyas pa rig pa rgya mtsho/ rnam pa zhes grags pa mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag na gnas so/ /de'i phyi ma dpal mngon par mi snang ba'i tshig rkang 'bum pa/ de phyi ma kha sbyor rgyud dang bla ma ste/ bshad pa'i rgyud ni lnga ru 'dod/ /ces gsungs so/ /bde mchog gi nges brjod bla ma las/ 'byung dang mkha' 'gro kun spyod dang / /kun nas bkod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la sogs pa'o/ /gsung gi rgyud la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud sgyu 'phrul chen mo le'u gsum pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud gsang ba chen mo/ khu yug rol pa/ grags pa bzang po/ ye shes mchog la sogs pa'o/ /thugs kyi rgyud la rtsa ba'i rgyud/ dpal nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i le'u 'bum bde mchog pa/ de'i phyi ma mngon par brjod pa/ byin rlabs kyi rtog pa sho lo ka 'bum pa/ de'i phyi ma le'u lnga bcu rtsa gcig pa/ ming 'bum pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud la dgongs pa rab 'byams pa ston pa mkha' 'gro bde mchog ma kun spyod chen mo/ rdo rje slob dpon dang slob ma'i las ston pa he ru ka bde mchog sngon 'byung /

bskyed rim ston pa bde mchog nges brjod bla ma/ rdzogs bde mchog rim dang las tshogs 'ba' zhig ston pa phag mo sngon 'byung / las tshogs kho na ston pa las rgya mtsho/ mngon gcod ston pa dus 'byung ba/ slob dpon gyi bya ba ston pa sdom pa rgya mtsho/ 'phrin las bzhi ston pa sngags kyi rgya mtsho/ dbang bzhi ston pa lta ba'i rgya mtsho/ rlung gi las sdom pa 'byung bde mchog dang brgyad do/ /'di dag ni phal cher bde mchog gi rgyud do/ /ba/ brtul zhugs ston pa sangs rgyas thod pa/ yon tan bcu gnyis dang sgo bstun pa sbyangs pa rol pa gnas pa la sogs pa las gdams pa/ a ra li nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa yan lag dang 'phros pa'i rgyud grangs las 'das pa bzhugs so/ /yon tan gyi rgyud la rtsa rgyud phyag rgya chen po ye shes thig le/ saṃ bhu ṭa bde rgyas thun mong gi rgyud do/ /bshad pa'i rgyud la sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor/ thig le kun 'byung / khro bo rol pa/ dpal mchog bde ba/ rab tu gsal ba la sogs pa'o/ /'phrin las kyi rgyud la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud gser gyi char pa/ rgyud phyi ma rgyan chen po/ bshad pa'i rgyud la de nyid rnam gsal/ 'jig rten mnyes pa/ yid bzhin 'khor lo/ don yod rgya mtsho/ ye shes mkha' 'gro la sogs pa'o/ /de nas gnyis su med pa'i rgyud la gnyis te/ 'jam dpal dang / dus 'khor ro/ /'jam dpal la 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul dra ba/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba/ rdo rje grub pa/ don yod pa/ gsang rgyud la sogs pa ste/ kha cig ni spyod pa'i rgyud du 'dod/ kha cig bya ba'i rgyud du 'dod/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dam pa dang po/ de las bsdus pa le'u lnga pa/ bshad pa'i rgyud la sangs rgyas 'byung ba/ thod pa'i rgyud che chung / dum bu nye bar bzhag pa la sogs pa'o/ /'di dag ni rgya bod gnyis su spyod pa che long tsam brjod pa ste/

bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab rab 'byams la/ bsam par yang mi nus la brjod par yang mi lang ngo / /zhes rje btsun bla ma'i gsung ngo / /da ni phyi nang la sogs pa'i khyad par la gnyis te/ spyir gsang sngags phyi nang gi khyad par dang / sgos pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po la gnyis/ smin lam gyi khyad par dang / grol lam gyi khyad par ro/ /dang po rig pa'i dbang tsam las mi 'dod na phyi pa ste/ dpal ye shes gsang ba las/ bum pa chu yi dbang bskur bas/ /bya ba'i rgyud la zhugs pa yin/ /cod pan gyi ni dbang bskur bas/ /spyod pa'i rgyud la zhugs pa yin/ /rdo rje dril bu byin pa yis/ /rnal 'byor rgyud du rtogs pa 'o/ /zhes so/ /dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par bskur na nang pa ste/ he badz+ra las/ slob dpon gsang ba shes rab dang / /bzhi pa yang ni de bzhin no/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /grol lam la bzhi ste/ sgom pa gnas kyi dang / bya rim spyod pa'i dang / yo byad snod kyi dang / longs spyod rdzas kyi khyad par ro/ /gnas ni rgyal po'i khang bzang dang / ri rab kyi steng la sogs par gtsang mar mos pa byed na sngags phyi pa ste/ gtsang sbrar gnas par bshad pa'o/ /gnas dur khrod kyi dbus sam/ shri dha na'am/ o rgyan la sogs par mos pa byed na nang pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo 'am/ /yang na dben pa'i bas mtha' ru/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'o/ /spyod pa'i khyad par ni/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa gtso bor byed na phyi pa ste/ bsam gtan phyi ma las/ 'bags pa dang ni ma dag pa/ /dogs pa'i 'du shes byung ba yang / /dben par gtsang sbra gnas par bya/ /zhes so/ /sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la 'jol nyog tu bsten na nang pa ste/ gsang 'dus nas/ bshang lci khu ba khrag la sogs/ /spyad pas dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /snod kyi khyad par ni/ rin po che'i snod la sogs pa brtson par byed na phyi pa/

kā pa la la sogs pa brtson par byed na nang pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig par/ /chang ni bzang pos yongs bkang ste/ /bla ma la phul skal chen ma/ /phyag btsal nas ni rang yang 'thung / /zhes so/ /rdzas kyi khyad par ni/ bdud rtsi/ ka ra/ sbrang / 'o ma/ zho/ mar dang lnga la gtso bor byed na phyi pa/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la gtso bor byed na nang pa ste/ brtag gnyis las/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bu ram chang / /dug dang nim pa bu rdzas kyi/ /zhes so/ /de ltar na bya ba dang spyod pa dang rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum phyi ma'i mtshan nyid dang ldan la/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa ni nang pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pas na de ltar shes par bya'o// //da ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa la gsum yod kyang / re zhig pha rgyud ma rgyud kyi khyad par/ de la yang gnyis te/ sngon byung rgyal ba'i rnam rol dang / /rjes 'jug sgrub pa'i khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ skyes pa 'dul ba'i phyir du 'khor yang pho gtso che bar gsungs pas pha rgyud/ mo 'dul ba'i phyir mo la gtso che bar gsungs pas na ma rgyud de/ skyes pa 'dul bar mdzad don du/ /rnal 'byor pha yi rgyud rab bshad/ /btsun mo rnams ni 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rgyud rab bshad/ /ces so/ /rjes 'jug la bskyed rim sgom pa na 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i gnas su lha pho gtso che na pha rgyud/ mo gtso che na ma rgyud de/ de ni myong bas dang 'grub bo/ /rdzogs rim sgom pa na mtshan bcas te/ rlung la gtso bor byed pas na pha rgyud/ 'og sgo byang sems la gtso bor byed na ma rgyud de/ rin chen phreng ba'i rgyud las/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa ru/ /steng sgo rlung la zung du 'jug /shes rab rnal 'byor ma rgyud du/ /si la ga bur zung du 'jug /ces so/ /mtshan med 'od gsal la gtso bor ston na pha rgyud/ rim lnga las/ nam mkha'i ngos ltar mchog gyur pa/ /'od gsal ba ni de dmigs shing /

/'od gsal ba ni gnas thob nas/ /rang dga'i gzugs su skye bar 'gyur/ /zhes so/ /bde stong lhan skyes la gtso bor ston na ma rgyud de/ brtag gnyis las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes/ /gang du yang ni mi rnyed de/ /bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang / /bdag gis bsod nams la shes bya/ /zhes so/ /rgyud brtag pa la gnyis te/ ngo bo dang / dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rgyud mtshan nyid pa des shes shing khong du chud pa'i thabs gang zhig ste/ de'ang sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa rnams 'chad pa'o/ /ngag gis rjod byed gang yin pa dang / gzhung glegs bam du bkod pa la rgyud ces bya ste/ de ji ltar yin na/ rang gi blo la rang bzhin gyi rgyud gnas pa dang / sngar ma go ba'i sbyong byed gang zag gis glegs bam las rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir na/ rgyud brtags pa zhes bya ste/ dper na ra mo sha ra'i gtam rgyud dam/ sman spyad ston pa'i po ti bzhin no/ /dbye ba la gsum/ rtsa ba'i rgyud dang / rgyud phyi ma dang / bshad pa'i rgyud do/ /gnas ni ri rab kyi rtse mor brgya byin la sogs pa 'dul don du de nyid 'dus pa gsungs so/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed du lha'i bu dga' rab dbang phyug 'dul ba'i don du dpal mchog dang po gsungs pas dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud gsungs so/ /'dzam bu gling pa chos 'byung ba'i gnas su 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud gsungs so/ /gyad kyi yul ku sha'i tshal shing sa la'i drung du dges pa rdo rje gsungs so/ /ri bo 'bigs byed kyi rtse mor rdo rje rtse mo gsungs so/ /u rgyan gyi ri la gsang 'dus gsungs/ lho phyogs be ta'i tshal mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas su rdo rje gdan bzhi gsungs so/ /phyogs kyi lha bzhi yab tu byung ba ni pha rgyud yin la/ yum du byung ba ni ma rgyud do/ /yang thabs 'pho ba'i rang bzhin can rlung gtso cher ston pa pha rgyud/

lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes gtso bor ston pa ni ma rgyud do/ /de la rtsa ba'i rgyud ni/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' gang zhig gzhan la ma brten par gzhung du gsungs shing / phyi ma dag bshad gzhir gyur pa'o/ /rgyud phyi ma ni/ don bsdu ba dang / dka' ba spyod pa dang / bye brag gi cho ga bshad pa dag go /bshad pa'i rgyud ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i bka' gang zhig rtsa ba'i rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig ma grol ba gsal bar byed cing / don bsdus pa dag kyang rgyas par ston pa'o/ /de'ang dur khrod rmad du byung ba las/ thog mar gsungs pa rtsa ba'i rgyud/ /phyi nas gsungs pa bshad pa'i rgyud/ /mdo tsam ston pa rtsa ba la/ /gsal bar byed pa bshad pa'i rgyud/ /ces so/ /yang na rtsa ba'i rgyud ni gdags gzhi yin la/ bshad pa'i rgyud ni tshul lngas 'dogs par byed pa'o/ /tshul lnga ni/ ma tshang ba kha bskong ba dang / tshul mi 'dra ba gzhan du 'chad pa dang / mi gsal ba gsal byed pa dang / tshig don phye ste rnam par bshad pa dang / nges pa bskyed par byed pa'o/ /de yang phan yon dpag tu med pa'i rgyud las/ gdags bya rtsa ba 'dogs byed bshad/ /'dogs tshul ma tshang kha bskong dang / /tshul ni gzhan du ston pa dang / /mi gsal gsal bar bshad pa dang / /nges par ster ba rnams yin no/ /zhes so/ /rgyud sde spyi yi rnam par bzhag pa'i don/ /'thad ldan lung gi rgyan spras zhes bya 'di/ /blo chung bdag 'dras brtsams par mi nus kyang / /mkhas mang zhabs rdul spyi bor blangs pa dang / /rgyud sde kha yar don la blo sbyangs pas/ /rje yi gsung don rgyud la goms pa'i phyir/ /'thad ldan lung gi rgyan spras 'di bkod pas/ /'gro ba'i don la lhag bsam yod na yang / /dman pas sbyar bas gzhan phan re ba chung / /'on kyang rnam par dag pa'i blo yod phyir/ /brgyud pas 'di don kun gyis rtogs gyur cig /rdo rje theg pa spyi'i rnam par bzhag pa/ 'thad pa'i don la/

'thad pa'i lung rgyan gyis spras pa zhes bya ba/ sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang pos mar yul du sbyar ba'o/ /dge slong bzang po'i mtha' can gyis sbyar ba'o// //gang mo grub pa dpal bzang gis sbyar ba yin/ rgyud las/ rang rig rtogs pa sangs rgyas te/ /ma rtogs 'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa can/ /de phyir rang rig rtogs byas la/ /'khor ba'i gzhi rtsa gcad par bya/ /zhes gsungs so/ /ri brgyad ni/ shar du rin po che'i ri lhun po/ byang du maṇ+ya ra ljang khu/ nub tu ke la sha dkar po/ lho ru ma la ya ser po/ dbang ldan du dbang chen nag po/ mer spos ngad ldan ser po/ bden bral du gangs can dkar po/ rlung du dpal gyi ri sngon po'o// //dge'o// //gcig zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 50 lo chen rin chen bzang po/ rgyud sde spyi'i rnam bzhag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 51
